problem: Nadia's birthday party began with 9 children playing games in the backyard. Her cousins were stuck in traffic, but at last 6 of them came running through the gate. Once the cousins arrived, how many children were at the party?

follow_ups.question: Each child ate 2 slices of pizza. How many slices did the children eat?

problem: In the school garden, 14 sunflowers were open on Monday morning. After two warm, sunny days, more buds opened, and now 23 sunflowers are open. The tallest one is already 95 centimetres high. How many sunflowers opened during those two days?

follow_ups.question: By Friday, 5 more buds had opened. How many sunflowers were open on Friday?
The class wants 40 open sunflowers for a photo. How many more do they need?

problem: Grandpa Tomasz filled a crate with pears from the old tree by the gate. Then his grandchildren climbed the ladder and added 38 pears from the top branches. Now the crate holds 85 pears. Work out how many pears Grandpa picked on his own.

The scouts gathered 17 sticks for the campfire before dinner. The fire had to last until bedtime, so Ravi went back into the woods and brought 8 more sticks. Owls had started hooting in the trees. How many sticks did the scouts have then?

follow_ups.question: They burned 12 sticks before bedtime. How many sticks were saved for the morning?

problem: Mei's family went hiking on a forest trail, and Mei counted the painted markers on the trees so they would not get lost. She had counted 11 markers when they stopped for lunch. When they got back to the car, her count was 26. How many markers did she count after lunch?

follow_ups.question: Her brother counted 4 fewer markers than Mei on the whole walk. What was his count?
Together, how many markers did Mei and her brother count?
Next month they will hike the same trail twice. How many markers will Mei pass on those two hikes?

problem: Some families had put up umbrellas on the beach early in the morning. When it got hot around noon, 27 more families arrived and put up their umbrellas too. Then there were 64 umbrellas on the sand altogether. How many umbrellas were up in the morning?

follow_ups.question: The lifeguard says the beach has room for 90 umbrellas. How many more could still fit?
Later, 8 more families came, each with one umbrella. How many spaces were left after that?

problem: Ines stood on the bridge and counted 12 ducks in the river below. She tossed some bread crumbs onto the water, and 8 more ducks swam out of the reeds to get them. What was the number of ducks under the bridge after that?

follow_ups.question: Half of the ducks were brown. How many brown ducks were there?

problem: Kofi and his uncle rented a small boat for 20 dollars and rowed out onto the lake. By mid-morning they had caught 6 fish. They stayed out until lunchtime, and when they rowed back the bucket held 15 fish. Find the number of fish they caught after mid-morning.

The music teacher keeps the class recorders in a big wooden box. This week the school bought 26 new recorders so that every student could have one, and they went into the same box. Now there are 61 recorders in it. How many recorders were in the box before the new ones came?

follow_ups.question: There are 58 students in the music classes. How many recorders are spare when each student takes one?
The teacher orders 15 more recorders for next year. How many spare recorders will there be then?

problem: Ms Okafor's art class was making a paper chain to hang across the classroom. On Monday the children made 34 links. The chain still did not reach the window, so on Tuesday they made 25 more links. How long is the chain now, in links?

follow_ups.question: The chain needs 80 links to reach the window. How many more links must they make?

problem: At the science fair, 18 people visited Yuki's volcano table in the morning. In the afternoon even more people came to watch it erupt, and by the end of the day 45 people had visited. Her volcano was made of clay and painted brown. Work out how many people visited in the afternoon.

follow_ups.question: Yuki had printed 30 leaflets and gave one to each afternoon visitor. How many leaflets were left?
Her friend gave her 9 more leaflets for tomorrow. How many leaflets does she have now?

problem: On Tuesday morning the pet shop got a delivery of 9 goldfish, and the owner let them swim into the big tank with the other goldfish. Now there are 24 goldfish in the tank. How many goldfish were in the tank before the delivery?

follow_ups.question: During the day, customers bought 7 goldfish. How many goldfish are in the tank now?
Each goldfish costs 3 dollars. How much money did the shop get for the goldfish it sold?
The owner wants 30 goldfish in the tank again. How many should she order?

problem: Rabbits got into Arjun's garden and nibbled some of the plants, so only 47 carrots were left in the long bed. Arjun planted a second bed, and 36 more carrots grew there. How many carrots does Arjun have now?

follow_ups.question: He gives a dozen carrots to his neighbour. How many carrots does he keep?

problem: Sofia was picking plums in her aunt's orchard. Her basket held 13 plums when she moved over to the next tree, which was 4 metres tall. After picking from that tree, she had 31 plums. How many plums came from the second tree?

Around the campfire, a few campers were toasting marshmallows. When the guitar started to play, 5 more campers came over from their tents. Now 13 campers are sitting by the fire. How many were there before the music started?

follow_ups.question: Each camper toasts 2 marshmallows. How many marshmallows do they need?
The bag has 40 marshmallows in it. How many will be left over?

problem: Dmitri and his dad were hiking up to a lookout. They climbed 58 stone steps and then stopped by a waterfall, because Dmitri's legs were tired. After a drink of water they climbed another 37 steps and reached the top. How many steps did they climb in all?

follow_ups.question: On the way down they took a path that skipped 49 of the steps. How many steps did they walk down?

problem: Lucia found 16 shells near the rocks. She wanted a full bucket, so she walked along the edge of the water and picked up more. Now she has 30 shells in all. How many shells did she find by the water?

follow_ups.question: She gives half of her shells to her little brother. How many shells does Lucia keep?
Her brother already had 7 shells of his own. How many shells does he have now?
They put all their shells into one bag. How many shells are in the bag?

problem: Canoes were tied up at the river dock. On Saturday morning a school group paddled in and tied up 8 more, and after that there were 20 canoes at the dock. Find how many canoes were there before the school group arrived.

follow_ups.question: Each canoe holds 2 people. How many people can all the canoes at the dock carry?
If 6 canoes paddle away, how many canoes will be left at the dock?

problem: On the fishing trip, Grandma Rosa caught 29 small perch in the morning. The lake was very calm and the sky was grey. In the afternoon she caught 43 more. What was the total number of perch she caught that day?

Hamza is learning to play songs on the keyboard. At the start of the term he knew 7 songs. His teacher lent him a songbook with 40 pages, and now he can play 15 songs. So far this term, how many new songs has Hamza learned?

follow_ups.question: He wants to know 20 songs by the summer concert. How many more songs does he need to learn?

problem: The jar on the art table now holds 21 paintbrushes, because the teacher just added 9 new brushes from a box. How many brushes were in the jar before that?

The science fair opened at 9 in the morning. By noon, 46 projects were set up in the hall. After lunch a bus from another school brought 23 more projects. By the afternoon, how many projects were in the hall?

follow_ups.question: The judges looked at 30 projects before taking a break. How many projects did they still have to judge?
After the break they judged 25 more. How many projects were still waiting?

problem: Spring is when many families buy pet rabbits, so the pet shop owner ordered extra rabbit food. On Monday there were 28 bags on the shelf. After the delivery truck came on Wednesday, the shelf had 75 bags. How many bags did the truck bring?

follow_ups.question: Over the weekend, 19 bags were sold. How many bags are on the shelf now?

problem: Kai's mum had tied some balloons to the fence for his birthday party. She blew up 14 more and tied them on too, so now there are 32 balloons on the fence. Kai's favourite colour is green. How many balloons were on the fence at first?

follow_ups.question: The wind blew 5 balloons away. How many balloons are still on the fence?
At the end of the party, Kai gave 8 balloons to his friends to take home. How many were left on the fence?

problem: Rain was coming, so Farmer Liang hurried to pick his apples. By lunch he had filled 23 boxes. In the afternoon his two nephews came to help, and together they filled 16 more boxes. When the rain started, how many boxes were full?

follow_ups.question: His truck can carry 50 boxes. How many more boxes could fit on the truck?
He loads the full boxes and sells 15 of them at the market. How many full boxes are still on the truck?
He gives half of those boxes to the school kitchen. How many boxes does the school kitchen get?

problem: The campground shop sells food to campers. On Friday it had 36 cans of beans on the shelf. Before the busy weekend a ranger drove in with a new supply, and now the shop has 82 cans altogether. How many cans did the ranger bring?

follow_ups.question: Over the weekend campers bought 58 cans. How many cans are left?

problem: Some hikers were resting at the top of the trail. A little later, a school group of 15 children reached the top, and then there were 22 people there. Before the school group came, how many hikers were resting at the top?
Ahmed built a sandcastle and decorated it with 24 shells. His sister found 18 more shells near the 3 big rocks and pressed them into the castle walls. How many shells are on the sandcastle now?

follow_ups.question: A wave washed away 9 shells. How many shells are still on the castle?
Ahmed wants 50 shells on it. How many more shells does he need to find?

problem: A family of beavers was building a dam across the river. Early in the summer the dam had 54 big sticks in it. By autumn the beavers had added many more, and a park ranger counted 91 sticks. Find out how many sticks the beavers added.

follow_ups.question: In winter, the ice broke 16 sticks loose. How many sticks were in the dam after the winter?

problem: Lena had some worms in a jar for the fishing trip. Her dad dug up 12 more worms in the garden, so now the jar holds 30 worms. How many worms did Lena have before her dad helped?

follow_ups.question: At the lake they used 21 worms. How many worms are left in the jar?
Lena let 4 of the leftover worms go in the grass. How many worms does she take home?
At home she puts them in a flowerpot that already has 6 worms. How many worms are in the flowerpot now?

problem: The school band had 26 students before winter. After the winter concert, 9 more students joined because they loved the music. The band teacher plays the trumpet. How big is the band now?

follow_ups.question: For the spring concert, the students stand in 5 equal rows. How many students are in each row?
If 2 more students are added to every row, how many students will be in each row?

problem: Clara had 27 beads on her necklace string. She wanted it to go all the way around her neck, so she kept threading beads until there were 45 on the string. How many beads did she add?

At the science fair, a robot show was about to begin in the gym. Some parents had already found seats when 37 more people came in from the hallway, making 82 people in total. How many people were seated before the hallway crowd came in?

follow_ups.question: There are 90 chairs in the gym. How many chairs are empty?

problem: A pet shop had 12 kittens in its play pen. The animal shelter, which is 6 kilometres away, drove over 7 more kittens that needed homes. Work out how many kittens were in the pen after that.

follow_ups.question: On Saturday, families adopted 11 of the kittens. How many kittens stayed at the shop?

problem: Javier set out 15 chairs for his sister's birthday party. More guests came than expected, so he carried extra chairs in from the kitchen. In the end there were 24 chairs around the table. How many chairs did he carry from the kitchen?

follow_ups.question: Every chair had a guest, and each guest got 2 cupcakes. How many cupcakes were needed?
The baker had made 60 cupcakes. How many were left after every guest got theirs?

problem: Mrs Park planted a long row of radish seeds in her garden. Some sprouts poked up in the first week. During the second week, 47 more sprouts came up, and now the row has 83 sprouts. In the first week, how many sprouts came up?

After the first group took theirs, the camp leader had only 18 flashlights left in the storage box. Then the second group came back from their night walk and returned 9 flashlights. How many flashlights are in the box now?

follow_ups.question: Each tent gets 3 flashlights. How many tents can the box supply?

problem: Priya collects pinecones on the trail behind her house. When she set out, her bag held 8 pinecones from yesterday. When she got home, it held 25. How many did she pick up on this walk?

follow_ups.question: She paints 10 of them gold for decorations. How many are not painted?
She gives 6 unpainted pinecones to a friend. How many unpainted ones does she have left?
How many pinecones does Priya have now, painted and unpainted together?

problem: Some kites were already flying above the beach on a windy afternoon when a kite club arrived with 28 more kites and launched them all. The sea was full of surfers. Then there were 63 kites in the sky. How many kites were flying before the club arrived?

follow_ups.question: The wind dropped and 17 kites came down. How many were still flying?
When the wind picked up again, 9 kites went back up. How many kites were flying then?

problem: Fourteen frogs sat on lily pads near the riverbank. As the evening got cooler, 8 more frogs hopped out of the water to join them. The river there is 2 metres deep. How many frogs were sitting on lily pads then?

follow_ups.question: A heron flew over and 5 frogs jumped back into the river. How many frogs stayed on the lily pads?

problem: Omar's tackle box had 6 hooks at the start of summer. Before his fishing trip he bought a new pack at the shop by the pier, and now he has 18 hooks. What number of hooks came in the pack?

follow_ups.question: He lost 3 hooks on underwater rocks. How many hooks does he have now?
His friend borrowed 5 hooks. How many hooks are still in Omar's box?

problem: Children were practising in the music room for the spring show. When the bell rang, 11 more came in carrying their drums, and now 26 children are in the room. The show is in 3 weeks. How many children were practising before the bell?

follow_ups.question: The teacher has 30 music stands. How many stands are not used if each child gets one?

problem: The art room shelf had 45 clay pots drying on it. Then the afternoon class finished their pots and set 38 more on the shelf to dry. What is the number of pots drying on the shelf now?

follow_ups.question: Mr Haddad moved 29 dry pots to the kiln room. How many pots are still on the shelf?
In the kiln, 4 of those pots cracked. How many of the pots in the kiln room did not crack?
The pots that did not crack go back on the shelf. How many pots are on the shelf now?

problem: Bao grew a bean plant for his science fair project. When he started measuring it was 9 centimetres tall, and two weeks later it was 23 centimetres tall. He drew a chart of its growth on his poster. By how many centimetres did the plant grow?

follow_ups.question: In the next week it grew 6 more centimetres. How tall is it now?
Bao hopes it will reach 40 centimetres. How many more centimetres does it need to grow?

problem: The pet shop owner opened a box of 16 squeaky toys and dropped them into the dog toy bin. Now the bin has 40 toys. How many toys were in the bin before?

Teodor's mum had only 37 juice boxes left after the school picnic, so she was worried about his birthday party. Then his aunt arrived with 48 more juice boxes. With the aunt's juice boxes, how many do they have for the party?

follow_ups.question: There are 29 guests, and each guest drinks 2 juice boxes. How many juice boxes will be left over?

problem: Bees were buzzing around the lavender in the community garden. Zainab counted 13 bees at first. A few minutes later the sun came out from behind a cloud, and she counted 21 bees. How many more bees had flown over to the lavender?

follow_ups.question: There were twice as many bees on the sunflowers as on the lavender. How many bees were on the sunflowers?

problem: Elif had some cherries in her bucket when her grandmother called her in for lunch. After lunch she picked 25 more from the low branches, and then the bucket held 60 cherries. The orchard has 70 cherry trees. How many cherries were in the bucket before lunch?

follow_ups.question: Elif ate 6 cherries on the way home. How many were left in the bucket?
Her grandmother used 50 cherries for a pie. How many cherries were left after that?

problem: On a bird-watching hike, the guide's list showed 46 birds by the time the group reached the halfway sign. On the way back they spotted 39 more birds near the pond. Find the number of birds the group spotted on the whole hike.

Early in the morning there were 15 swimmers in the sea. When the lifeguard raised the green flag, more people ran into the water, and soon there were 32 swimmers. How many people ran in after the flag went up?

follow_ups.question: At lunchtime 20 swimmers came out to eat. How many were still in the water?

problem: Rafts were floating down the river in a summer race. At the bend, 9 more rafts joined from a side stream, and the officials then counted 27 rafts. Everyone wore a bright orange life jacket. How many rafts were in the race before the bend?

follow_ups.question: After the bend, every raft had 2 people on it. How many people were rafting?
Near the finish line, 4 rafts tipped over and dropped out. How many rafts finished?
Every person on a raft that finished got a medal. How many medals were given out?

problem: Kalani and her brother went crabbing off the old pier. Kalani caught 8 crabs in her net before lunch. After lunch the tide came in and she caught 13 more. What was Kalani's catch for the whole day?

follow_ups.question: Her brother caught 5 fewer crabs than she did. How many did he catch?
At sunset they let all their crabs go back into the sea. How many crabs did they let go?

problem: Mrs Novak's choir needed more voices for the winter concert, so she put up posters around the school. Before the posters, 38 children sang in the choir. Afterwards the choir had 73 singers altogether. How many children joined because of the posters?

follow_ups.question: The stage has 8 rows with 10 places in each row. How many places are empty when all the singers are on stage?

problem: Wen has been in the art club for 2 years, and she always brings her own crayons. For her birthday her aunt gave her 24 more crayons, so now her box holds 50. Before her birthday, how many crayons did Wen have?

Rohan's class built a model town for the science fair, with tiny cardboard solar panels on the roofs. By Thursday they had glued on 32 panels. On Friday morning they added 17 more. How many solar panels are on the model now?

follow_ups.question: They want 60 panels in total. How many more do they need?
They have enough cardboard left for only 8 more panels. How many panels will still be missing?

problem: The bird cage at the pet shop held 34 budgies in the morning. At noon a breeder brought a crate of young birds, and once they were moved in, the cage held 61 budgies. Find how many budgies were in the crate.

follow_ups.question: The cage is safe for at most 70 birds. How many more budgies could the shop put in?

problem: Grandma baked some cupcakes for Aiyana's birthday. When Aiyana's dad came home with 12 more from the bakery, there were 30 cupcakes in total on the table. How many cupcakes did Grandma bake?

follow_ups.question: The guests ate 22 of the cupcakes. How many were left?
Aiyana split the leftover cupcakes equally between her 2 neighbours. How many did each neighbour get?

problem: Hiro planted 15 tulip bulbs along the garden path last autumn. His neighbour had some extra bulbs and gave them to him, so in spring Hiro planted 12 more. Altogether, how many tulip bulbs has Hiro planted along the path?

follow_ups.question: All but 3 of the bulbs grew into tulips. How many tulips grew?
Hiro picked 8 tulips for his mother. How many tulips are still in the garden?
His sister plants 9 more tulips next to them. How many tulips are in the garden now?

problem: Mr Achebe's orchard stand had 46 jars of apple jam on the shelf. Before the weekend market he brought more jars up from the cellar, and now the shelf holds 82 jars. His jam labels are painted by hand. How many jars did he bring up from the cellar?

follow_ups.question: On Saturday he sold 57 jars. How many jars are still on the shelf?

problem: When the scout bus pulled into the campsite at 5 o'clock, some tents were already standing in the meadow. The scouts put up 9 more tents before dark. Now there are 23 tents in the meadow. Find how many tents were standing when the bus arrived.

Twelve teams entered the sandcastle contest at the beach that morning. When the tide went out and there was more sand to build on, the judges let 7 more teams join. How many teams were in the contest then?

follow_ups.question: Each team had 2 children. How many children were building sandcastles?
The judges had 50 flags and gave one to every child. How many flags were left?

problem: Ngozi collected flat stones on the riverbank for skipping, and her best throw skipped 6 times. She had 11 stones in her pocket, then found more under an old willow tree. Now her pocket holds 20 stones. Work out how many stones she found under the willow.

The fishing club keeps a tally of every fish its members catch during the summer. On the last weekend of summer, members caught 38 more fish, and the tally reached 96. What was the tally before the last weekend?

follow_ups.question: The club's record for one summer is 99 fish. How many more fish would they have needed to match it?

problem: In music class, Mr Alvarez taught the children a new drum beat. They played it 16 times on Monday and 18 more times on Wednesday, until everyone could keep in step. Drums can be very loud. How many times did they play the beat this week?

follow_ups.question: On Friday they played it twice as many times as on Monday. How many times did they play it on Friday?
How many times did they play the beat on Monday, Wednesday and Friday together?
Mr Alvarez wants them to reach 80 times before the concert. How many more times must they play it?

problem: Ji-woo's sticker book had 30 stickers in it. In art class everyone designed their own stickers, and Ji-woo added her new ones to the book. Now it has 42 stickers. How many new stickers did she add?

follow_ups.question: Each page holds 6 stickers, and every page with stickers is full. How many pages are full?
The book has 10 pages. How many pages are still empty?

problem: The science fair committee printed programmes for visitors on Friday. On Saturday morning the volunteers saw there would not be enough, so they printed 45 more, which made 93 programmes altogether. How many programmes were printed on Friday?

follow_ups.question: By the end of the fair, 87 programmes had been handed out. How many were left?

problem: The pet shop's hamster cage had 14 hamsters. Then a family that was moving to another city brought in 5 of their hamsters so the shop could find them new homes. How many hamsters live in the cage now?

Presents were piling up on the table at Malia's 7th birthday party. When the first guests came, there were 6 presents on the table. By the time the cake came out, there were 19. What number of presents did the later guests bring?

follow_ups.question: Malia opened 8 presents before the cake. How many were still wrapped?
Her little brother helped her open 4 more. How many presents were still wrapped then?

problem: By July, the Andersson family had a few pumpkins growing in their garden. In August the vines spread and 29 more pumpkins appeared. Now there are 64 pumpkins. How many pumpkins were growing by July?

follow_ups.question: The family gives 48 pumpkins to the school for carving. How many pumpkins do they keep?

problem: At the orchard's pick-your-own day, Isla filled her bag with 21 peaches. Her dad wanted to make jam, so he picked 18 more peaches and put them in the bag too. How many peaches ended up in the bag?

follow_ups.question: They used 25 peaches for the jam. How many peaches were left?
Isla and her brother each took half of the peaches that were left. How many peaches did each of them get?

problem: The night sky over the campsite was clear, so Freya lay on her sleeping bag and at first counted 23 stars. As it got darker, more stars appeared, and soon she counted 41. A fox was rustling in the bushes nearby. How many more stars appeared as it got darker?

follow_ups.question: A cloud covered 9 of the stars she had counted. How many could she still see?
Her brother counted 5 more stars than she could still see. How many did he count?
How many more stars did her brother count than Freya saw at the very start?

problem: A few trail runners had already reached the water station. Then 13 more runners came jogging up the hill, and the volunteers counted 31 runners at the station. How many runners were there before the group came up the hill?

follow_ups.question: Each runner took 2 cups of water. How many cups did the volunteers hand out?

problem: On Monday a ranger counted 56 salmon in the pool below the waterfall. She noticed fewer fish jumping than usual. By Thursday, 37 more salmon had swum up from the sea into the pool. On Thursday, how many salmon were in the pool?

Grandpa Amir keeps his fishing floats in an old tin. Before the trip to the lake there were 9 floats in it. He went to the bait shop, which has been open for 50 years, and came back with enough floats to make 24 in the tin. How many floats did he buy?

follow_ups.question: At the lake he lost 4 floats in the reeds. How many floats are left in the tin?
He gives a quarter of the remaining floats to his grandson. How many floats does the grandson get?

problem: The music room has a shelf of tambourines. After the school bought 7 new tambourines for the parade, the shelf held 19 of them. How many tambourines were on the shelf before?

follow_ups.question: On parade day, 15 children each took one tambourine. How many were left on the shelf?

problem: The art class is making a big mosaic out of coloured tiles. Last week they glued down 58 tiles. This week they glued 34 more so the sun in the picture would be finished. How many tiles are on the mosaic now?

problem: The science fair raffle had 27 tickets in the drum before lunch. After lunch more visitors bought tickets, and then there were 50 tickets in the drum altogether. How many tickets were bought after lunch?

follow_ups.question: The organisers pulled out 3 winning tickets. How many tickets were left in the drum?
Each winner gets 2 prizes. How many prizes were given out?

problem: How many puppies were at the pet shop on Friday, if a breeder brought 6 more on Saturday and then the shop had 15?

For Kirra's birthday treasure hunt, her dad hid 45 chocolate coins around the park. The children found them so quickly that he hid 36 more coins for a second round. The park has a big oak tree. What is the total number of coins he hid?

follow_ups.question: The children played in 3 teams and shared all the coins equally between the teams. How many coins did each team get?

problem: Juan's grandmother has a bird feeder in her garden, which has a fence 30 metres long. At breakfast there were 8 sparrows on the feeder. She put out more seed, and by lunch there were 22 sparrows. How many sparrows came after she put out the seed?

follow_ups.question: A cat walked past and 13 sparrows flew away. How many were still on the feeder?

problem: At harvest time the workers carried 8 more ladders out of the barn to add to the ones already leaning against the apple trees. Now 20 ladders stand in the orchard. How many were leaning against the trees before?

problem: Sione packed 15 marshmallows for the camping trip. At the campsite store he bought a bag with 20 more marshmallows for 4 dollars. After shopping, how many marshmallows did Sione have?

problem: Ayesha has a hiking passport, and a ranger stamps it at every trail checkpoint she reaches. At the start of the summer she had 38 stamps. By the end of the summer she had 65. How many stamps did she earn this summer?

follow_ups.question: A gold badge needs 80 stamps. How many more stamps does Ayesha need?

problem: Seagulls were standing on the sand near the pier when a fisherman threw out a bucket of scraps, and 16 more seagulls flew down. There were 34 seagulls on the sand then. Seagulls are very noisy birds. How many seagulls were there before the scraps were thrown?

How many of the seagulls that flew off did not come back?

problem: Mateo's grandfather was cleaning out his garage and found his old fishing lures. He gave 13 of them to Mateo, who already had 26 lures in his tackle box. Find how many lures Mateo has now.

follow_ups.question: Mateo's tackle box has 3 trays, and he puts the same number of lures in each. How many lures go in each tray?

problem: The school orchestra had 39 instruments in its storeroom. A local music shop donated some violins and cellos, and now the storeroom holds 76 instruments in all. How many instruments did the shop donate?
Students hung their paintings on the art room wall. After Thursday's class, 9 more paintings went up, which made 25 paintings on the wall. How many paintings were there before Thursday's class?

follow_ups.question: The teacher takes down 7 paintings to send to an art show. How many are still on the wall?

problem: For her science project, Leila counted 23 ladybugs in one corner of the school field. Two days later, 15 more ladybugs had arrived at the same spot. Her magnifying glass makes things look 4 times bigger. How many ladybugs were at the spot then?

problem: The pet shop's talking parrot, Captain, knew 35 words when the shop bought him. The owner taught him new words every day, and now Captain knows 62 words. How many words has the owner taught him?

problem: Arash's mum was getting sweets ready for the party bags. She poured 18 more sweets from a new packet into a bowl that already had some in it. Now the bowl has 42 sweets. How many sweets were in the bowl before?

follow_ups.question: She puts 6 sweets in each party bag. How many bags can she fill?
